abstract: Nine tumour lines with different developmental capacities were derived from spontaneous as well as from one induced teratocarcinoma: three teratocarcinoma-derived rhabdomyosarcomas TDR 602, TDR 694, and TDR 114; two teratocarcinoma-derived neuroblastomas TDN 2151 and TDN 2283; two teratocarcinoma-derived endodermal tumours TDE 274 and TDE 113; one multipotential teratocarcinoma OTT 2289, and one undifferentiated teratocarcinoma OTT 2158. Quantitative analyses of ten catabolic enzymes, i.e. alkaline and acid phosphatase, alpha- and beta-galactosidase, alpha- and beta-glucosidase, alpha-mannosidase, alpha-fucosidase, beta-glucuronidase, and hexosaminidase were carried out at the 20-cell level, and specific enzyme activity profiles were established for each of the tumour lines studied. These profiles may be used for the biochemical identification of a tumour type at the single cell level in addition to morphological and biological criteria.
abstract_ja: 奇形癌由来の横紋筋肉腫3株（TDR 602、TDR 694、TDR 114）、奇形癌由来の神経芽腫2株（TDN 2151、TDN 2283）、奇形癌由来の内胚葉性腫瘍2株（TDE 274、TDE 113）、多分化能を有する奇形癌1株（OTT 2289）、未分化奇形癌1株（OTT 2158）の計9系統の腫瘍株を作製した。酸性および中性ホスファターゼ、α・β-ガラクトシダーゼ、α・β-グルコシダーゼ、α-マンノシダーゼ、α-フコシダーゼ、β-グルクロニダーゼ、ヘキソサミニダーゼの10種の異化酵素について、20細胞レベルで定量解析を行い、各腫瘍株に特異的な酵素活性プロファイルを作成した。これらのプロファイルは、形態学的および生物学的指標に加えて、単一細胞レベルで腫瘍型を生化学的に同定するために用いられる可能性がある。
